title: Former OU Coach Sherri Coale speaks at Rotary Club of Tulsa luncheon - NewsBreak
text:
8 hours ago TULSA, Okla. — Sherri Coale, the former head coach of the University of Oklahoma women’s basketball team, spoke at a Rotary Club of Tulsa luncheon on Wednesday.
Coale led the Sooners to multiple NCAA Final Four appearances and was inducted into the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame.
Since stepping away from coaching, Coale has focused on writing and public speaking, using her experiences to connect with others.
“Writing clarifies things for me,” Coale said. “It gives me an opportunity to think, and I think a lot of what I share is pretty universal and can affect a lot of people. When you spend your life in coaching and teaching, it's all about impact, and this was a way to continue to do that without the lifestyle of a major college coach.”
Coale said she enjoys speaking at Rotary events because of the organization’s impact on the community.
